$description: NCSSM YAC type tokens. Montserrat for everything, as NCSSM's brand guide sets it. The slide scale is what the Claude Design decks use on the 1920 x 1080 canvas. The web scale is derived from it and has not been used in a shipped page yet.

sans.usage: Everything: titles, body, labels, numbers. NCSSM's primary font; Verdana is NCSSM's named substitute.

serif.usage: NCSSM's secondary font, to complement Montserrat (the NCSSM Foundation wordmark is a serif). Not used in YAC decks so far; if you use it, keep it to long-form text or a pull quote.

regular.usage: Rare in slides; body text there is Medium.

semibold.usage: Leads, emphasised body, footers, panel text.

statement.usage: Headline-as-statement on content slides. 104-120 depending on length.

quote.usage: Catalyst tagline, in Catalyst orange on Midnight. 44 on Paper.

lead.usage: Cover subtitle, statement subtitle, the one line after a title.

body-large.usage: One-line items beside an accent rule (announcements).

body.usage: Default body in cards and columns.

card-title.usage: Name of a card (a family, a team).

secondary.usage: Supporting line under body, in Slate. 32 under body-large.

eyebrow.usage: Section label above a title, after the catalyst dot.

label.usage: Block label (h3) on cards, columns and panels.

label-small.usage: Agenda section names, sub-labels, QR captions.

footer.usage: Presenter · slide number, bottom right, in Slate.
